cost.scope: server finite run; record/source/role/transfer times are subsets of observed process total, not additive again. Local development/packaging/MCP/people cost excluded. No speed comparison or learning cost verdict.

role_coverage.scope: all 8-token bijections role stage (4 Hamming equivalence classes), fixed Program/Config/initial

stage_transfer.scope: role(64)->pair(16) is exhaustive across all 4^2 Hamming-distance pairs for all 40320 3-bit bijections; or0..4(121), triple(64), projection(272), and consume(32) are extremal [min,max] interval-boundary checks across the 6-stage relational chain, not 64^n full product enumeration
